levels.title: Supported concrete communication
levels.exit_promise: Handle concrete personal details and immediate needs with learnt language and a collaborative partner.

reception.listening: Recognise familiar words and very basic phrases when delivery is slow, clear, and context-supported.
reception.reading: Understand familiar names, words, signs, and very simple sentences in predictable material.

production.speaking: Use isolated simple phrases and sentences for personal details, familiar people, places, possessions, and needs.
production.writing: Produce isolated phrases and sentences and complete very simple personal-detail forms or messages.

interaction.oral: Ask and answer simple questions with repetition, rephrasing, slower speech, and formulation help.
interaction.written_online: Post simple greetings or reactions and complete a very simple purchase or personal-details form.
interaction.mediation: Relay simple predictable information from short signs or notices and show welcome, interest, or understanding.

language_control.range: Very basic expressions and some one-clause structures for concrete personal information and needs.
language_control.grammar: Limited control of a few learnt simple structures and sentence patterns.
language_control.vocabulary: Basic words and phrases tied to particular concrete situations.
language_control.pronunciation: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.
language_control.discourse: Link words or groups mainly with very basic linear connectors such as and or then.
language_control.fluency: Manage very short pre-packaged utterances with substantial pausing and repair.

assessment_evidence: A new concrete personal or immediate-need task
No copying of a complete model
Support may clarify but not supply the response

levels.title: Routine direct communication
levels.exit_promise: Complete simple routine exchanges and describe the immediate world through linked simple language.

reception.listening: Understand high-frequency language of immediate relevance and the main point of short clear messages.
reception.reading: Read short simple texts and locate predictable information in everyday materials and personal correspondence.

production.speaking: Use a series of simple phrases and sentences to describe family, background, routines, and immediate surroundings.
production.writing: Produce a series of simple phrases and sentences linked by frequent connectors.

interaction.oral: Complete routine tasks and short social exchanges through direct familiar information exchange.
interaction.written_online: Handle basic social interaction, routine transactions, simple instructions, and supported collaboration.
interaction.mediation: Convey main points of short simple everyday texts and collaborate on practical tasks with occasional repetition.

language_control.range: Basic patterns and memorised phrases for predictable everyday content, with message compromise outside routine situations.
language_control.grammar: Some simple structures are correct, though systematic basic mistakes remain and meaning is usually clear.
language_control.vocabulary: Sufficient for routine transactions, basic communicative needs, and simple survival situations.
language_control.pronunciation: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.
language_control.discourse: Link simple sentences with frequent connectors such as and, but, and because.
language_control.fluency: Make short understandable contributions with visible hesitation, false starts, and reformulation.

assessment_evidence: Successful repair after a bounded misunderstanding

levels.title: Connected familiar independence
levels.exit_promise: Operate independently in familiar life, travel, work, and personal-interest situations using connected language.

reception.listening: Understand main points of clear standard input and relatively clear media on familiar or personally relevant topics.
reception.reading: Understand high-frequency everyday or job-related texts and descriptions of events, feelings, and wishes.

production.speaking: Connect phrases to narrate experiences and events and give brief reasons for opinions, hopes, and plans.
production.writing: Produce straightforward connected text on familiar or personally interesting topics.

interaction.oral: Enter unprepared conversation on familiar topics and handle most common situations while travelling.
interaction.written_online: Interact about experiences and feelings, ask for clarification, and answer comments in some detail.
interaction.mediation: Convey familiar information from clear texts, seek simple compromise, and support shared communication.

language_control.range: Sufficient familiar-topic language for some unpredictable situations, with hesitation and circumlocution when limits appear.
language_control.grammar: Reasonable accuracy in familiar contexts; errors and first-language influence remain but intended meaning is clear.
language_control.vocabulary: Good range for familiar topics and everyday life, with limitations on unfamiliar or complex ideas.
language_control.pronunciation: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.
language_control.discourse: Link shorter elements into a connected linear sequence with simple paragraphing and chronological control.
language_control.fluency: Keep going comprehensibly despite evident pauses for planning and repair.

assessment_evidence: A reasoned response in more than one context

levels.title: Detailed independent communication
levels.exit_promise: Understand and produce clear detailed language, sustain viewpoints, and interact with useful spontaneity.

reception.listening: Follow extended talk and complex argument on reasonably familiar topics and understand most standard-language news and film.
reception.reading: Understand articles and reports with viewpoints, contemporary prose, and relevant technical discussion.

production.speaking: Give clear detailed descriptions and explain a viewpoint with advantages, disadvantages, and supporting detail.
production.writing: Produce clear detailed texts, essays, and reports that present information or support a position.

interaction.oral: Participate actively with useful fluency and spontaneity, sustain views, and manage routine disagreement.
interaction.written_online: Collaborate in multi-person tasks and handle misunderstanding when others remain reasonably cooperative.
interaction.mediation: Relay detailed information and arguments reliably, clarify complex points, and develop or connect others' ideas.

language_control.range: Broad general and field-related language, viewpoints, argument, and some complex sentence forms without much restriction.
language_control.grammar: Relatively high control with occasional slips and some rigid or inaccurate use of complex forms.
language_control.vocabulary: Good general and field-related range with systematic use of many appropriate collocations.
language_control.pronunciation: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.
language_control.discourse: Use varied linking expressions, cohesive devices, supporting detail, and clear logical paragraphs.
language_control.fluency: Sustain longer stretches at a fairly even tempo with few conspicuously long pauses.

assessment_evidence: A supported viewpoint for a new audience and topic

levels.title: Flexible complex communication
levels.exit_promise: Use English flexibly for complex social, academic, and professional purposes, including implicit meaning.

reception.listening: Understand extended discourse with implicit relationships and demanding media without excessive effort.
reception.reading: Understand long complex factual, literary, specialised, and technical texts while appreciating style distinctions.

production.speaking: Present complex subjects with integrated sub-themes, developed points, and an appropriate conclusion.
production.writing: Produce clear well-structured detailed texts on complex subjects in a style appropriate to the reader.

interaction.oral: Express ideas fluently and precisely, adapt register, and relate contributions skilfully to others.
interaction.written_online: Handle complex abstract interaction and communication problems through flexible register, clarification, and exemplification.
interaction.mediation: Convey significant ideas from long complex texts and evaluate and connect multiple perspectives.

language_control.range: Broad complex language selected flexibly for clear social, academic, and professional communication.
language_control.grammar: Consistently high accuracy; errors are rare and difficult to notice.
language_control.vocabulary: Broad lexical and idiomatic command with effective circumlocution and little obvious searching.
language_control.pronunciation: Full phonological range with intelligibility throughout; retained accent does not affect effectiveness.
language_control.discourse: Produce smooth, well-structured language with controlled organisational patterns and cohesive devices.
language_control.fluency: Express complex thought almost effortlessly, with only conceptually difficult material affecting flow.

assessment_evidence: A complex position in multiple domains
Audience and register adaptation without rehearsed wording

levels.title: Precise nuanced synthesis
levels.exit_promise: Synthesize complex sources and communicate precise nuances with consistently appropriate language.

reception.listening: Understand virtually all live or broadcast language, including fast natural delivery after reasonable accent familiarisation.
reception.reading: Read with ease virtually all abstract, structurally complex, specialised, and literary written language.

production.speaking: Deliver smooth logically structured communication that highlights significant points and fine shades of meaning.
production.writing: Create complex letters, reports, articles, summaries, and reviews in an effective reader-appropriate style.

interaction.oral: Participate effortlessly, use idiomatic language appropriately, and repair so smoothly that difficulty is unobtrusive.
interaction.written_online: Use an appropriate tone in virtually any interaction and anticipate cultural, emotional, or communication problems.
interaction.mediation: Reconstruct and evaluate arguments, convey nuance and sociocultural implications, and guide complex discussion sensitively.

language_control.range: Comprehensive precise language that differentiates, emphasises, and eliminates ambiguity without visible restriction.
language_control.grammar: Consistent control of complex language even while attention is divided across planning and interaction.
language_control.vocabulary: Very broad idiomatic and colloquial repertoire with awareness of connotation and fine meaning distinctions.
language_control.pronunciation: Precise articulation and prosody enhance subtle meaning; retained accent does not reduce intelligibility or effectiveness.
language_control.discourse: Create fully coherent and cohesive communication using flexible organisational and rhetorical patterns.
language_control.fluency: Sustain natural effortless flow, pausing mainly to select the most precise formulation or example.

assessment_evidence: Precise nuance under realistic cognitive load

issues: Record-level CEFR and GSE mappings above A1 are not yet normalized.
Grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation lifecycle ownership is not yet reviewed.
C2 lexical selection needs a method beyond the Oxford levelled lists.
